accepted_limitations: This is a source-only review. It grants no execution, retry, resume, refill, overwrite, training, scientific-claim, navigation, promotion, deployment, or successor-pilot authority.

The authorized follow-on, if separately issued, is one non-citable sizing_calibration_only attempt over eight calibration scenes, sixteen states, and 160 branches. It performs no model training and establishes no WM-A, world-model generalization, recursive rollout, planning-regret, or closed-loop navigation result.

The source now rejects bounded_wm_a_pilot authority. A claim-bearing or development WM-A pilot needs a separate frozen plan, reviewed supervisor, source review, and exact authority after this calibration emits FREEZE_PILOT_CONTRACT; no automatic follow-on is authorized.

Repeated-action sentinels are an exact deterministic replay gate. Because the checker requires exact executed tapes, trajectories, endpoints, and stored RGB, they do not estimate a stochastic noise distribution; the physical rank contract uses a fixed 1e-6 m numerical floor.

The renderer validates camera quality and endpoint-pose replay while using solid materials and box-physics geometry. The calibration therefore establishes no parity with the textured training RGB domain and cannot support a visual-domain fidelity claim.
Physical fall, tip, progress, path, and endpoint trajectories are receipted at the 50 Hz policy cadence. They do not establish 2 ms swept clearance, contact, recoverability, or production safety.
GPU memory telemetry is selected-device global VRAM, sampled from sysfs, and is not process-attributed. Concurrent GPU work can inflate the measured baseline, peak, and delta.
The authority network_access=false field is a policy restriction, not network-namespace isolation.

Installed third-party package contents are version-receipted rather than recursively hash-closed. The interpreter target, environment configuration, exact runtime inputs, GPU identity, and execution selectors are separately bound and revalidated before reservation.

The eight exact ordinary TRAIN scene IDs are calibration-only identities and must remain excluded from all future train and evaluation roles. The successful calibration receipt and downstream consumer enforce that exclusion contract.

The output root must remain fresh. Pre-reservation validation or platform failure consumes no attempt, but any failure after reservation consumes the sole attempt; no retry, resume, overwrite, or refill path exists.

One-shot durability depends on preserving the attempt directory and its immutable receipts after reservation. This review did not launch the simulator, create the attempt root, decode RGB leaves, deserialize checkpoint tensors, or inspect any sealed or test-split payload.
